sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: driving privilege, DUI penalties, breath tests, interlocks and violation fines
Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, including drivers under the legal drinking age who face their own penalty track.
Why it matters to a first-timer: first-offense DUI penalties are dense exact-figure items [A02], and implied consent and the interlock threshold are frequent concept items [A04].
Level: heavy exact-figure recall (fines, hours, months, BAC bands) with a few concept rules; high load because many ranges look alike.
Prerequisites: the BAC limits and breath-test basics in the drinking, drugs and health section.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
